name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.4 degrees north of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 8 visits over 68 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 24 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.9 days starting 2025-08-25, at wavelengths from 1.24 to 4.13 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
